data.narrative: Mastered production containerization principles by constructing an optimized multi-stage Dockerfile and security-hardened container environment. Articulated trade-offs between Alpine and Debian Slim base images, isolated build toolchains from minimal runtime artifacts, enforced non-root execution (appuser:appgroup), and rapidly resolved the BREAK cache-busting defect by restoring manifest-first layering and .dockerignore boundary enforcement.

dimension_scores.observation: Constructed an industry-standard multi-stage Dockerfile separating the builder stage (full dependencies, Prisma codegen, TypeScript compilation) from the runtime stage (pruned production dependencies, compiled dist bundle, non-root user).
dimension_scores.evidence: Engineered Dockerfile with node:20-slim, USER appuser, active HEALTHCHECK /live, and .dockerignore preventing context bloat.

dimension_scores.observation: Demonstrated deep appreciation of deterministic build pipelines, caching mechanics, and artifact separation necessary for upstream CI/CD runners.
dimension_scores.evidence: Structured layer order to maximize Docker layer cache hits on package manifests before copying application source.

dimension_scores.observation: Configured proactive container liveness probing via Docker HEALTHCHECK instruction against dedicated /live endpoint with appropriate interval, timeout, and retry thresholds.
dimension_scores.evidence: Configured HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=10s --retries=3 CMD curl -f http://localhost:${PORT:-3000}/live || exit 1.

dimension_scores.observation: Anticipated production failure modes including host container escapes, credential leaks via unignored build contexts, and build-time cache thrashing.
dimension_scores.evidence: Implemented unprivileged system user appuser:appgroup to bound blast radius against host breakout and enforced .dockerignore excluding .env secrets.

dimension_scores.observation: Designed service health probing to distinguish process liveness (/live) from dependency readiness (/ready), preventing orchestration thrashing during transient dependency cold starts.
dimension_scores.evidence: Added dual /live and /health route handlers ensuring container orchestrator does not kill booting containers before dependencies initialize.

dimension_scores.observation: Documented container architecture, layer ordering mechanics, image size optimization rationale, and security hardening decisions with clear technical explanations.
dimension_scores.evidence: Recorded comprehensive verification proof in progress/module_01_verify_proof.json and diagnosis in progress/module_01_break_diagnosis.json.

strengths: Rigorous container security engineering: enforces non-root execution and least-privilege system user (appuser:appgroup)
Deep mastery of Docker layer caching: correctly orders manifest copies before application source to prevent cache invalidation storms
Clean separation of build vs runtime concerns: uses multi-stage builds to ensure devDependencies and compilers never enter production images
data.recommendation: Carry containerization best practices forward into Module 02 by automating image build, vulnerability scanning, and testing in CI/CD pipelines.

public_evidence.student_action: Created multi-stage Dockerfile with Debian Slim base image, non-root user (appuser), and automated health check.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Multi-stage builder pattern with node:20-slim, useradd appuser, and HEALTHCHECK targeting /live
public_evidence.proof: Verified container runtime execution and 200 OK response on http://localhost:3000/live.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Minimizes container image attack surface, eliminates build toolchain bloat, and enforces non-root least privilege in production.

public_evidence.student_action: Configured build context ignore rules to eliminate workspace bloat and prevent secret leakage.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Excludes .git, .env, .env.*, node_modules, and test files from Docker build context
public_evidence.proof: Eliminated repository history and sensitive environment files from image context.
public_evidence.ability: Container Build Context Isolation & Secret Protection
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Accelerates build context transfers and prevents accidental leakage of version control histories or environment secrets into production images.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Separated builder and runner stages in Dockerfile to isolate dev tooling and keep runtime image minimal.
Diagnosed and corrected layer inversion where source copy preceded npm install, restoring build cache speed.
Configured appuser system account and switched USER appuser before CMD execution.

teaching_approaches.detail: Examined cache-busting and context bloat during BREAK step to internalize instruction order importance.
